cases.title: Navigator stuck in local minimum — which escape paths are topologically valid?

graph_context.description: TritonNavigator has been in the same simplex region for 14 exploration steps. Spectral gradient norm near zero. Two topological holes (B1=2) detected nearby. Singularity proximity high.

events.message: SingularityDetector: resonance_outlier detected at proximity 0.91, B1=2

candidates.text: North ridge path — 7 edges. Betti B1 transition: crosses a topological hole boundary. Spectral gradient alignment 0.78. Singularity proximity decreases along path to 0.31.
Spiral exit path — 5 edges. Golden-angle step sequence, aligns with Fiedler gradient direction. Betti B0 preserved. Expected singularity proximity after: 0.22.
Local loop path A — 4 edges. Stays within the current simplex neighborhood. Spectral gradient alignment 0.06. Betti numbers unchanged. Does not reduce singularity proximity.
Local loop path B — 6 edges. Variant of the same local neighborhood. Spectral gradient alignment 0.08. Increases singularity proximity slightly.
Gradient descent path — 9 edges. Follows raw energy gradient without topological constraint. Spectral alignment 0.44. Crosses B1 hole interior — topologically invalid.
Backtrack path — 3 edges back to previous visited node. Spectral gradient alignment 0.02. Returns to already-explored region with no topological improvement.
Cached exploration history for this navigator session. Lists all visited nodes, step counts, and gradient values across 14 iterations.
Topology baseline from initialization. Records initial Betti numbers, simplex structure, and spectral decomposition at exploration start.
